terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Basic guidelines when you create an account, manage conversations and use features in the system.
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or using the Inbox System Management system, you agree to comply with these terms. If you do not agree, please do not continue using the service.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for securing your login credentials, password and all activities occurring in your account. Notify the administrator if you detect unusual access.
terms.s3Body: Do not use the system to send illegal content, spam, fraud, harassment, spread malicious code or violate the privacy of others.
terms.s4Body: You retain rights to your generated content, but allow the system to process that data to operate features such as messaging, conversation management, notifications, and customer support.
terms.s5Body: We may suspend or terminate access if an account violates the terms, poses a security risk or affects the experience of other users.
terms.s6Body: Terms may be updated when the product changes. The new version will take effect when posted in the system.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How the system collects, uses and protects personal data when you work with accounts, conversations and attachments.
privacy.dataUsage: Data is used to operate and protect the service
privacy.noSelling: We do not sell personal data
privacy.s1Body: The system may store account information such as full name, email, phone number, avatar, status, conversation content, attachments and login session history.
privacy.s2Body: Data is used to authenticate accounts, display profiles, operate messaging, sync online status, send notifications and protect the system from unauthorized access.
privacy.s3Body: Passwords are stored as one-way hashes. You should set a strong password, not share login info, and log out of unused devices.
privacy.s4Body: We do not sell personal data. Data is only shared when necessary to operate the service, comply with legal requests or handle security incidents.
privacy.s5Body: Data is kept for the time necessary for operational purposes. When an account is disabled or deleted, related data may be handled according to the system retention policy.
privacy.s6Body: You can update your profile, change your password, log out of the current session and contact the administrator for personal data support.
